draft.shortGloss: to hurt; to be bad for
draft.emotion: aching and tired, complaining about a sore spot
notes: For body aches, use an indirect object pronoun (mi, ti, gli/le...) and make 'fare' agree with the body part: 'mi fa male la testa' (my head hurts), 'mi fanno male i piedi' (my feet hurt).
With a reflexive pronoun ('farsi male'), it means to hurt or injure oneself.

senses.definition: To cause physical or emotional pain, or to ache.
